content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Semi-supervised anomaly detection methods can incorporate labelled anomalies as must-outside constraints during kernel optimisation, and self-training iteratively assigns pseudo-labels to unlabelled samples and retrains a classifier.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-00960","field":"abstract","quote":"incorporates labelled anomalies as must-outside constraints during kernel optimisation"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-00962","field":"abstract","quote":"Self-training iteratively assigns pseudo-labels to unlabelled samples and retrains a classifier"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Anomaly detection at the network edge requires balancing model accuracy against strict memory budgets and latency targets, and the quantised convolutional network fits within 200 KB while achieving 97% of its full-precision AUPRC on the ARM board.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-00963","field":"abstract","quote":"Deploying anomaly detection at the network edge requires balancing model accuracy against strict memory budgets and latency targets"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-00963","field":"abstract","quote":"The quantised convolutional network fits within 200 KB and achieves 97% of its full-precision AUPRC while meeting a 5 ms per-window latency budget on the ARM board"}]},{"claim":3,"text":"Concept drift and label scarcity in high-dimensional, heavily imbalanced time-series data can be addressed through anomaly detection and classification methods.","sources":[{"id":"R0071","field":"bio","quote":"Her group focuses on anomaly detection and classification in high-dimensional, heavily imbalanced time-series data, including methods for handling concept drift and label scarcity"}]}]}
